name: Vector Quantization Precision Distortion & Reconstruction Error
description: To compress embeddings from 32-bit floats to 8-bit integers, engineers evaluate the reconstruction error (distance between uncompressed and quantized vector) to measure fidelity loss.
prompt:
To compress embeddings from 32-bit floats to 8-bit integers, engineers evaluate the reconstruction error (distance between uncompressed and quantized vector) to measure fidelity loss.

Execute the required analytical SQL calculation in DuckDB.
Expected output columns: vector_id, l2_quantization_error, cosine_distortion.
Results should be ordered as specified.
golden_sql:
-- Evaluate Euclidean distortion and cosine fidelity loss per vector
            SELECT 
                vector_id,
                ROUND(array_distance(fp32_vec, quantized_vec), 6) AS l2_quantization_error,
                ROUND(1.0 - array_cosine_similarity(fp32_vec, quantized_vec), 6) AS cosine_distortion
            FROM vector_compression_test
            ORDER BY l2_quantization_error DESC;
why_it_fails: Deploying quantized embeddings without evaluating distortion leads to silent degradation in search accuracy.
